title: Almost Permutation
statementMd:
Recently Ivan noticed an array $*a*$ while debugging his code. Now Ivan can't remember this array, but the bug he was trying to fix didn't go away, so Ivan thinks that the data from this array might help him to reproduce the bug.

Ivan clearly remembers that there were $*n*$ elements in the array, and each element was not less than $1$ and not greater than $*n*$. Also he remembers $*q*$ facts about the array. There are two types of facts that Ivan remembers:

- $1$ $*l*_{*i*}$ $*r*_{*i*}$ $*v*_{*i*}$ — for each $*x*$ such that $*l*_{*i*} ≤ *x* ≤ *r*_{*i*}$ $*a*_{*x*} ≥ *v*_{*i*}$;
- $2$ $*l*_{*i*}$ $*r*_{*i*}$ $*v*_{*i*}$ — for each $*x*$ such that $*l*_{*i*} ≤ *x* ≤ *r*_{*i*}$ $*a*_{*x*} ≤ *v*_{*i*}$.

Also Ivan thinks that this array was a permutation, but he is not so sure about it. He wants to restore some array that corresponds to the $*q*$ facts that he remembers and is very similar to permutation. Formally, Ivan has denoted the $*cost*$ of array as follows:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/342f605898c735054e25c41dbdc08dd267c11446.png), where $*cnt*(*i*)$ is the number of occurences of $*i*$ in the array.

Help Ivan to determine minimum possible $*cost*$ of the array that corresponds to the facts!

## Input

The first line contains two integer numbers $*n*$ and $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 50$, $0 ≤ *q* ≤ 100$).

Then $*q*$ lines follow, each representing a fact about the array. $*i*$-th line contains the numbers $*t*_{*i*}$, $*l*_{*i*}$, $*r*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$ for $*i*$-th fact ($1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 2$, $1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $*t*_{*i*}$ denotes the type of the fact).

## Output

If the facts are controversial and there is no array that corresponds to them, print `-1`. Otherwise, print minimum possible $*cost*$ of the array.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
最近，Ivan 在调试代码时注意到了一个数组 $*a*$。现在 Ivan 已经记不起这个数组了，但他当时试图修复的 bug 仍然存在，因此 Ivan 认为这个数组中的数据可能有助于他重现该 bug。

Ivan 清楚地记得，数组中有 $*n*$ 个元素，并且每个元素都不小于 $1$ 且不大于 $*n*$。此外，他还记得关于该数组的 $*q*$ 条信息。Ivan 记得的信息有以下两种类型：

- $1$ $*l*_{*i*}$ $*r*_{*i*}$ $*v*_{*i*}$ — 对于满足 $*l*_{*i*} ≤ *x* ≤ *r*_{*i*}$ 的每个 $*x*$，都有 $*a*_{*x*} ≥ *v*_{*i*}$；
- $2$ $*l*_{*i*}$ $*r*_{*i*}$ $*v*_{*i*}$ — 对于满足 $*l*_{*i*} ≤ *x* ≤ *r*_{*i*}$ 的每个 $*x*$，都有 $*a*_{*x*} ≤ *v*_{*i*}$。

Ivan 还认为这个数组是一个排列，但他对此并不确定。他希望还原出一个满足所记信息，并且与排列尽可能相似的数组。形式化地，Ivan 将数组的 $*cost*$ 定义为：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/342f605898c735054e25c41dbdc08dd267c11446.png)，其中 $*cnt*(*i*)$ 表示数组中 $*i*$ 出现的次数。

请帮助 Ivan 求出满足这些信息的数组的最小可能 $*cost*$！

## 输入

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 50$，$0 ≤ *q* ≤ 100$）。

接下来有 $*q*$ 行，每行描述一条关于数组的信息。第 $*i*$ 行包含 $*t*_{*i*}$、$*l*_{*i*}$、$*r*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$，表示第 $*i*$ 条信息（$1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 2$，$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ *r*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*t*_{*i*}$ 表示信息的类型）。

## 输出

如果这些信息相互矛盾，不存在满足条件的数组，则输出 `-1`。否则，输出数组的最小可能 $*cost*$。
</statement>
